Privacy policy

Last updated 30 November 2025.

What we collect

Northwind Analytics stores warehouse table metadata: table names, schema names and write timestamps. It does not read or store row data from your warehouse.

Account data

We store the name, work email and organisation of each user, so that alerts can be routed and billing can be issued.

Retention

Run history is kept for 30 days on the Team plan and 12 months on the Scale plan. Account data is deleted within 30 days of an account closing.

Contact

Data protection enquiries go to hello@taxonomy-demo.test or to Northwind Analytics Ltd, 14 Fenchurch Avenue, London EC3M 5BN.
